saw_lines: Supplement buyers ask how it ships and whether others trust it before they add a new brand to the cart.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a buyer clicks to a page.
Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so open ads for new buyers with delivery time and cost.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains how it ships, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so the question stays open for new buyers. Open ads for them with one line on delivery time and cost, then link the shipping page.
0 of 30 ads show a proof number, so a first buyer has nothing to measure against. Take one figure you can stand behind, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead new ads with it.
0 of 22 copy ads carry an offer that stays open, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Lead three new ads with a first order discount on the Starter Paket, which ends on a set date.

Your 22 copy ads use 13 different openings, and the picky child opener leads 3 of them. Build the next batch from the two best stories only, the picky child and the kids omega-3 story, so the best stories get repeated.

ads_1: Delivery and first order creative built on the picky child and omega-3 openings
